title: aaj dunya me mohammad mustafa paida hua
body:
aaj dunya me mohammad mustafa paida hua
qaasa e rabbe do aalam muqteda paida hua
<<DIVIDER>>
jis ki qatir ye zameeno aasma'n paida hua
maalike kouno makaa'n arzo samaa'n paida hua
<<DIVIDER>>
farsh se islaam phaila baaniye islaam se
deene haq kaamil hua noore quda paida hua
<<DIVIDER>>
qush hai abdullah aur makke me sab hai shaadmaa'n
aamena ka raahate jaa'n dilruba paida hua
<<DIVIDER>>
haan utho aye momino tazeem ko padh kar durood
kashtiye ummat ki qaatir na quda paida hua
